rule_basis.author_local_constraint: I10: long wick at least 3x body; local, not a full formula
assumptions: Adjacent strict high/low containment; equals excluded; no mother-Bar recursion
Nonzero body; other wick <= body; wick direction independent of candle colour
Morphology confirmed at completed 5m close; no active-signal lifetime
Next supplied-row close strictly outside signal high/low; observation, not permission

author_comparison.detail: 本地09:10严格内包、09:15收盘下破能解释一种几何机制；仅暂定视觉对应，不证明作者Bar或保护规则。
作者图顶1034.5，本地暂定峰1035，相差+0.5；保留未解释差异。
其他图解缺唯一作者Bar、完整OHLC或周期；无法对齐，不能统计逐根命中。结构仅保留作者图注，不自动选点。
